role.altitude: The mechatronics engineer keeps setting requirements, choosing materials and sensors, testing on the bench and commissioning lines; updating document registers by hand, mailing files, reading data sheet after data sheet and typing I/O lists shrink.
skills_to_grow: Working in the product data system with metadata
role.ambitious_version: An engineer who finds any file and any spec in seconds and spends the time on the machine.

tasks.short: Save documents to the project folder, update the document register, manage revisions, send updates to the team, and find files and versions to maintain technical project files.

steps.what: Engineer saves drawings, calculations and test results to the technical project files
Engineer updates the document register spreadsheet with number, revision and status
Engineer manages revisions and marks superseded versions
Engineer mails updated documents to the project team
Engineer searches for files and earlier versions when needed

tasks.design: Documents are saved in the product data system with number, revision and status as metadata, so the document register is generated from it instead of kept as a second spreadsheet. Revision control marks superseded versions when the engineer releases a new one. Team members subscribed to the project get a notice with a link, instead of mailed attachments. Files are found by metadata search instead of browsing folders. The audit trail is used for document control, not to judge engineers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Folders, a register spreadsheet and mail attachments had to be kept in step by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Product data systems with document control.
tasks.still_hard: Supplier documents that arrive without numbers.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which old revision a customer actually built to.
tasks.altitude: Most register and mail work goes; saving and releasing stay.

reach.learn: Whether work on superseded drawings stops.

evidence.claim: Spreadsheets and e-mailed review comments glue teams today; product lifecycle systems with document control replace them.
Systems that can check staff presence, behaviour or performance need works council consent.

assumptions: Boundary: maintaining project files; publishing engineering reports (task 16464) and mechanical design documents (task 16467) are sibling tasks.
s2 saves the second entry of each document in the register; s4 saves the mail transport of files.
Saving files keeps its full time; adding metadata takes about as long as naming the file did.
The works council consents before the audit trail is introduced.
research_questions: Do errors from superseded drawings fall?

incremental.description: Engineer fixes missing metadata on imported files.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: small projects with few documents; high: large projects with many revisions.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Define material requirements, search material databases and data sheets, compare and identify materials appropriate for mechatronic system designs, and record the choice.

steps.what: Engineer defines material requirements: loads, temperature, environment and cost
Engineer searches material databases and supplier data sheets
Engineer compares candidates and identifies the materials appropriate for the mechatronic designs
Engineer records the choice and rationale in the design file

tasks.design: A materials database with property filters (strength, temperature range, conductivity, cost class) gives a short list, instead of the engineer reading supplier data sheets one by one. The material field in the design file links the chosen grade to its data sheet, and the engineer adds the rationale. Defining requirements and choosing stay with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Data sheets were read one by one.
tasks.still_hard: New composites without full property data.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing how a plastic behaves after years of vibration.

reach.learn: Whether chosen grades are easier to source.

evidence.claim: Materials databases filter grades by property.

assumptions: Boundary: identifying materials; mechanical design documents (task 16467) and simulation models (task 23947) are sibling tasks.
Input contract for s2: the materials database covers about 70% of grades in use; s2 is priced at that share.
Defining and choosing keep their full time.
unknowns: Share of special grades outside the database.
research_questions: Is material selection quicker without later changes?

incremental.description: Engineer adds supplier grades to the database.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: special materials; high: common engineering grades.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Define requirements, research candidate sensors, communication technologies or control devices, compare and select them, test them on the bench, and record the selection.

steps.what: Engineer defines requirements for motion control, position sensing or pressure sensing
Engineer researches candidate sensors, communication technologies and control devices in catalogues and data sheets

loop.output: A comparison table of range, accuracy, interface and environment ratings with page references.
loop.check: The engineer checks each value against the cited page; values without a page stay empty.
loop.stop: Data sheets the step cannot read are compared by hand.
loop.why_not_simpler: Each maker lays out data sheets differently.

steps.what: Engineer compares and selects the devices
Engineer applies and tests the chosen devices on the bench
Engineer records the selection with data sheets and bench results

tasks.design: Parametric search in distributor catalogues narrows candidates, and an extraction step reads the data sheets into a comparison table with page references, which the engineer checks value by value. Comparing, selecting and bench testing stay with the engineer. The selection record links the comparison table and bench results instead of retyping them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Data sheets were read and compared by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Parametric catalogue search and data sheet extraction with page references.
tasks.still_hard: New devices with incomplete data sheets.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing a sensor will drift in this machine's heat.
tasks.altitude: Less reading data sheets; choosing and testing stay.

reach.learn: Whether chosen parts have stable supply.

evidence.claim: Parametric catalogue search and data sheet extraction with references are available tools.

assumptions: Boundary: selecting and applying devices; control circuits and algorithms (task 16473) and testing design solutions (task 16470) are sibling tasks.
Defining, selecting and bench testing keep their full time.
unknowns: Number of device selections per project.
research_questions: Is selection quicker without wrong parts ordered?

already_counted.description: Engineer checks extracted values against data sheets.

incremental.description: Engineer keeps the comparison template current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few, well-known devices; high: many new device types.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study the material flow, select and configure transfer equipment, have control logic programmed, commission and test on site, document the installation, and coordinate with operators and suppliers to apply automated solutions to the transfer of materials, components or finished goods.

steps.what: Engineer studies the flow of materials, components and finished goods on the floor
Engineer selects and configures transfer equipment such as conveyors, robots or automated carts
Engineer programs the control logic for the transfer equipment
Engineer commissions and tests the automated solution on site
Engineer documents the installation: I/O lists, parameters and operating instructions
Engineer coordinates with operators and suppliers

tasks.design: Studying the flow, configuring equipment, commissioning and coordinating stay hands-on. I/O lists and parameter tables are exported from the control project into the documentation template, instead of being typed by hand. The engineer writes the operating instructions.
tasks.previous_blocker: I/O lists and parameters were typed from the control project.
tasks.enabler_now: Exports from control projects into document templates.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing where a product will jam at the transfer point.

reach.learn: Whether documentation matches the installed system.

evidence.claim: An industrial assistant writes control code and HMI screens in the engineering platform at an automation engineering firm.
From January 2027 the Machinery Regulation covers AI safety functions.

assumptions: Boundary: applying transfer solutions; designing automation systems (task 16474) and control circuits or algorithms (task 16473) are sibling tasks.
s3 is part of implementing control algorithms, which sibling task 16473 covers; its saving is counted there.
Studying, configuring, commissioning and coordinating keep their full time.
unknowns: Number of transfer projects per year.
research_questions: Does documentation match the installed system more often?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: small changes; high: large lines with long I/O lists.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
